_about: App-release group registry for the andrew-middleware Worker (groups-update-2026-11-12). The owner-run update script deposits this JSON as the Worker secret MW_GROUP_REGISTRY; the Worker resolves every groups.* call against it. Addresses may be overridden on-device at run time (~/mw-group-registry.json) — see the package README.

groups.confirmation_note: DECIDED Nov 12, 2026 (Andrew, option (b)): 'Manual change and listen for change artifacts and activate any next actions.' Owners membership changes are made MANUALLY by Andrew in the Google Groups UI — the middleware NEVER executes an Owners change (groups.members.add/remove against Owners return needs_owner, state manual_only) and the approval-redemption protocol addition is NOT being built. This supersedes the earlier strong_gate / needs_approval preview encoding of runbook rule (d).
groups.enablement_note: Owners is the default audience on every release, always first; enabling the group on a release needs no special confirmation (runbook rule (a)). Enablement itself is Play Console state, not a middleware action.
groups.name: Apps-Release-Owners
groups.witness_note: groups.get on Owners stays ENABLED as the witness leg: for this group the middleware is read-only witness. A roster change observed via groups.get is surfaced by Muse and activates the standing next actions — verify Play tester-list implications, and sweep the records (TESTER-LINKS.md / unified-group-config.json / tester-groups.json). The witness activates only after the Workspace -> domain groups -> DWD chain lands and the settling groups.get test passes; until then, manual Owners changes are not observable to the middleware.

groups.confirmation_note: Adding a person needs Andrew's simple one-click confirmation at action time (runbook rule (c)); enforced at the caller layer by the standing click rule.
groups.consumer_note: RECORD ONLY — this consumer Google Group has NOT been created (Nov 12, 2026). In the Workspace plan the group is created fresh under the domain instead (tester-groups.json).
groups.name: Apps-Release-Early-Testers

groups.domain_note: No domain group for Family in the Workspace plan (tester-groups.json, Nov 12, 2026: 'no apps-release-family@ domain group is created for the release tier'). Family stays exactly as-is, unused for now; the Worker returns needs_owner/manual_only for this group and never calls its consumer address.
